newsitem.title: USA: Information Management files for initial offering.
newsitem.headline: Information Management files for initial offering.

text.p: Information Management Associates Inc said on Friday it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of 4.5 million shares.
The offering will be managed by Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Robertson, Stephens & Co and SoundView Financial Group Inc.
Information Management plans to use the proceeds to repay debt, as working capital and for other purposes.
Information Management makes customer interaction software for telephone call centers.
